summary: 16-year-old male skier collided with a tree on the Lower Ambush run at Eldora Mountain Resort ~11 a.m. Monday; rescue efforts unsuccessful, pronounced dead at the scene; identity withheld pending next-of-kin notification; coroner cause of death pending at publication
location: Lower Ambush run, Eldora Mountain Resort
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Eldora ski patrol
notes: One of two Eldora tree-collision fatalities the same weekend (companion: 2021-02-28 Jolly Jug).
